turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how have things been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ah, it's been a long day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I feel guilty taking breaks when I'm working from home.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lots of people feel that. At an office you'd take breaks without thinking, chatting at the coffee machine or walking to a meeting.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: True, I never thought of it like that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Short breaks actually help your focus. Your brain needs a reset every hour or so.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What should I even do in a five minute break?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Get away from screens. Stretch, step outside, make tea, look out of the window.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ideally not. It feels like a break, but your eyes and brain are still working.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good plan. Notice how you feel at four o'clock, that's usually when it shows.
